# Explorium

Explorium AgentSource provides company and prospect discovery, matching, enrichment, research, and usage management through its REST API.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/explorium/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete Filter Values** (read-only): Find normalized values for Explorium business and prospect search filters, including company names, job titles, industries, locations,…
- **Enrich Business Firmographics** (read-only): Enrich 1-50 Explorium business IDs with company firmographics.
- **Get Audience Stats** (read-only): Return aggregate distributions and total counts for either a business or prospect filter set before fetching records.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected Explorium company's allocated and remaining credits and trial or paid account type.
- **Get Job Status** (read-only): Get detailed status, timing, credit usage, errors, and downloadable CSV result metadata for one existing Explorium job.
- **List Jobs** (read-only): List existing Explorium asynchronous jobs, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, and return their IDs for detailed monitoring.
- **Match Businesses** (read-only): Resolve 1-50 business names, domains, URLs, or LinkedIn URLs to Explorium business IDs while preserving input order.
- **Match Prospects** (read-only): Resolve 1-50 people from names, employers, email, phone, LinkedIn URL, or Explorium business ID to prospect IDs while preserving input…
- **Search Businesses** (read-only): Search Explorium businesses with structured filters and cursor pagination.
- **Search Prospects** (read-only): Search Explorium prospects with strict person and employer filters, returning one cursor-paginated page.
